content.comment_body: Hello everyone! I have a project created using [product_name] [version_no] and [product_name] [version_no]. Recently, I updated to [product_name] [version_no] and [product_name] [version_no], because the new controllers I received have firmware [version_no]. The projects load without errors, but when I access the IP in my browser, I only see a "[company_name] Third-Party Software Disclosure [document]". How can I display my visualization instead? Thanks!
Have you enabled web server access in the access control settings? Also, have you activated the web user account?
I forgot about that step—haven't worked with [company_name] products for over a year. That solved the problem! Thank you!
Glad to hear it! Enjoy using the system.

analysis.insight_summary: The user encountered an issue viewing the intended interface on their controller after updating both firmware and software; a legal disclosure appeared instead of their visualization. The problem was caused by missing configuration steps after the update, specifically related to enabling web server and user access. This emphasizes the need for clear instructions and reminders about configuration requirements following system updates, especially for returning users.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects that after upgrading hardware and software versions, the visualization should be immediately available via the browser as previously, without needing extra configuration.
